ValidationRule.description: Prevents business users to change order status to any prior status in the predefined order process.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT($Permission.BypassValidations),
NOT( CONTAINS(
CASE(PRIORVALUE(Status),
"Draft", "Pending Credit Approval;Activated;SentToSAP;OrderReceivedBySAP;Paused;SAP Fulfillment Execution;Shipping;Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"Pending Credit Approval", "Activated;SentToSAP;OrderReceivedBySAP;Paused;SAP Fulfillment Execution;Shipping;Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"Activated", "SentToSAP;OrderReceivedBySAP;Paused;SAP Fulfillment Execution;Shipping;Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"SentToSAP", "OrderReceivedBySAP;Paused;SAP Fulfillment Execution;Shipping;Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"OrderReceivedBySAP", "Paused;SAP Fulfillment Execution;Shipping;Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"Paused", "SAP Fulfillment Execution;Shipping;Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"SAP Fulfillment Execution", "Shipping;Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"Shipping", "Canceled (Final – Lost);Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"Canceled (Final – Lost)", "Order Delivered (Final – Won)",
"Order Delivered (Final – Won)"),
TEXT(Status)
) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Status of the order cannot be reverted to a previous status.
